This section documents the Output (OUT) feature - providing analog signals with the RC (mostly current based).

Additionally, this chapter describes the SAFOUT feature ([SAFOUT](safety-relatedoutputs.html){.topiclink}) - clamping circuits using high and low sites for safety relevant outputs.
